BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY16-FY23 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-6.2%/yr (FY25 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.3-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24 median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.5%/yr (FY16-FY23 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +6.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY23 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2025-05-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.21x (-20.6% downside to Bear $56 / +98.1% upside to Bull $92) | Adj composite 2.45 vs market 1.36: gap +1.09 [UNDERVALUED] | -14% above the EPP floor $54 (14x FY25E $3.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +60.6% total (+30.3%/yr) | At 12.0x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $61 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues -7.1% in Q1 2025, forward revenues -5.2% to -3.1% (FY25 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
